subject: Engagement blueprint & phased rollout calendar — Polaris Systems
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@polaris-sys.com>, Ben Ortiz <ben.ortiz@polaris-sys.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Feb 2027 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Engagement blueprint & phased rollout calendar — Polaris Systems

Team — looping you in to transition Polaris to CS and lock the implementation timeline. Attaching the first-draft engagement blueprint and a phased rollout calendar. High-level summary and asks below: 

Attachments: polaris_engagement_blueprint_v1.xlsx (xlsx), redwood-implementation-checklist.pdf (pdf)

Quick summary:
- Pilot cohort (10 internal users) to validate embeddings/search, freshness, and latency on dedicated capacity. Preferred pilot window: Mar 15–Mar 28 (2 weeks).
- Staging verification: API key exchange + SSO test + data seeding by Mar 10.
- Data migration: nightly batch for historical index (owner: Polaris infra). Final cutover target: Mar 31.
- Go-live: Apr 1 with initial rate limits and scale to dedicated capacity week-by-week.
- Success criteria: 95th percentile latency < 350ms, relevance NDCG improvement > 12% vs baseline, no production incidents on day 1.

Asks:
1) Soojin: lead CS kickoff and customer readiness calls.
2) Monica: validate API contract and outline smoke tests for staging.
3) Karthik: confirm resource reservation (dedicated pool) and rollback plan.
4) Polaris: share SSO metadata, procurement target, and SOC evidence (Aisha).

Can we get a 30–45 minute kickoff next week (proposed: Mon 2/28 10–10:45 PT)? If that works, I'll send a calendar invite with the draft agenda.

Thanks —
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Dylan.Brooks@redwood.com

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@polaris-sys.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Feb 2027 10:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Engagement blueprint & phased rollout calendar — Polaris Systems

Thanks Dylan — reviewed the draft. A couple of clarifications from the implementation side: 

- Data migration owner: Polaris confirmed they will run the historical batch, but we need to confirm the index format. Requesting sample payloads by end of week.
- Smoke tests: I'll put together a checklist for API contract tests + embedding similarity checks; aiming to share by Fri 2/26.
- Staging quotas: need to know expected token volume during pilot so we can size the staging pool. Polaris, can you share estimated daily traffic for the pilot cohort?

I can host the kickoff if Soojin is on PTO. Proposed kickoff times that work on my end: Mon 2/28 10–10:30 PT or Tue 3/1 09–09:45 PT.

--
Monica Patel
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com

From: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@polaris-sys.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Ortiz <ben.ortiz@polaris-sys.com>, procurement@polaris-sys.com
Date: Thu, 25 Feb 2027 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Engagement blueprint & phased rollout calendar — Polaris Systems

Thanks Dylan — appreciate the clear plan. A few notes from Polaris: 

- Pilot window: current internal blackout weeks push our preferred pilot to Mar 22–Apr 4 (would that be feasible?), since we have an engineering freeze the week of Mar 15.
- SOC / compliance: attaching our vendor questionnaire and SSO metadata (saml_metadata.xml). We also need a SOC 2 Type II copy and an updated data retention summary before procurement signs the SOW.
- Procurement timeline: aiming to return the signed SOW by 3/5; can your legal team accept our standard redlines? We will upload the SOW to DocuSign (link below).

Attachments: polaris_vendor_questionnaire.pdf (pdf), saml_metadata.xml (xml)
DocuSign (SOW): https://www.docusign.com/DEMO/packet/0a9b-pol-sow

Cheers,
Aisha Khan
Sr. Program Manager, Polaris Systems
aisha.khan@polaris-sys.com

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@polaris-sys.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Ortiz <ben.ortiz@polaris-sys.com>
Date: Fri, 26 Feb 2027 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Engagement blueprint & phased rollout calendar — Polaris Systems

Aisha — thanks for the fast turnaround and the attachments. We can accommodate the revised pilot window (Mar 22–Apr 4) and will adjust the calendar. Below is a concrete, owner-assigned phased rollout calendar and acceptance criteria (feel free to push back):

Phase A — Prep & Staging (Mar 1–Mar 14)
- Owner: Soojin Lee (CS)
- Milestones: SSO metadata applied (Mar 3), API key exchange completed (Mar 4), sample payload validation (Mar 7)
- Validation: SAML login success, API smoke tests pass (5/5 endpoints), sample NDCG > 10%

Phase B — Pilot (Mar 22–Apr 4)
- Owner: Monica Patel (Solutions)
- Milestones: Data seed completed (Mar 21), pilot cohort onboarded (Mar 22), weekly check-ins (Mar 24, Mar 31)
- Validation: 95th pct latency < 350ms during baseline traffic window, no critical defects for 48h

Phase C — Scale & Go-live (Apr 5–Apr 18)
- Owner: Karthik Iyer (Impl)
- Milestones: Dedicated capacity reserved (Apr 5), throttles released incrementally (Apr 9), production cutover (Apr 12)
- Validation: Autoscale behaves as expected during peak, post-cutover monitoring green for 72h

Rollback criteria (agreed):
- Any sustained error rate > 2% over 15m window during pilot or scale phase; or latency regressions ≥ 40% vs baseline -> trigger rollback to prior model variant and pause scale.

Open items for Polaris:
1) Confirm estimated pilot daily token volume by Mon 3/1.
2) Procurement: confirm whether Polaris legal will accept our standard SLA clause or propose edits by 3/5.
3) Provide SOC 2 Type II PDF link to share with our Security team by 3/3.

I'll draft a concise MAP (mutual action items table) and share a single-sheet with owners/dates by EOD Mon 3/1. Proposed kickoff now set for Tue 3/2 09:00 PT (inv coming).

Thanks —
Soojin Lee
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com

Thanks — that looks good overall. Two asks from my side before the kickoff: 
1) Can we extend the pilot by one additional week (new pilot end Apr 11) to increase sample size for relevance evals?
2) Polaris will likely need a brief reserved spike of dedicated capacity for two peak windows during week 1 of pilot (Mar 23 10–13 PT and Mar 30 14–17 PT). What is the fastest way to reserve short bursts?

Also attaching our SOC 2 doc link (internal). Procurement will upload the SOW to DocuSign before EOD.

Attachments: polaris_soc2_typeII_link.txt (link stub)

Appreciate it —
Aisha Khan

Subject: Re: Engagement blueprint & phased rollout calendar — Polaris Systems

Aisha / Team — thanks, all agreed on the updated plan. Quick recap and confirmed changes: 

- Pilot extended to Mar 22–Apr 11 (three-week pilot), owners & milestones updated in the MAP.
- Dedicated spike windows for pilot week 1 (Mar 23 10–13 PT, Mar 30 14–17 PT) — Karthik to provision short bursts; recommended approach is a reserved burst grant routed through Dedicated onboarding (eta 24h confirmation once requested).
- Polaris procurement: we received the DocuSign packet link and will review redlines; legal will respond to procurement by 3/5.
- Open items: Polaris to send estimated token volumes by Mon 3/8; Polaris to confirm SOC 2 link by Thu 3/3 (noted received stub).

Next steps:
1) I will share the finalized MAP (one-pager) and updated phased rollout calendar to the shared drive (link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cPOLARIS) by EOD Thu 3/3.
2) Karthik will confirm dedicated spike provisioning procedure in the kickoff.
3) Monica to publish API contract checklist to the shared drive by Fri 3/5.

Thanks everyone — looking forward to kickoff on Tue 3/2 09:00 PT (calendar invite sent).

Best,
Soojin Lee
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com
